Filters map results by search keyword; 4 links in page but only 2 match 'blog'

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"map_search\":\"blog\",\"max_depth\":0,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.mapUrls(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.urls.count)
```
